snippet.title: Tabletop game Shop Simulator - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🧩 Wishlist Now on Steam 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3524750/Tabletop_Game_Shop_Simulator/

Welcome to Tabletop Game Shop Simulator – the ultimate cozy sim for board game lovers and collectors!

Run your dream tabletop store:
🛒 Stock shelves with miniatures, rulebooks & accessories
🎨 Mount and paint miniatures to boost their value
🎁 Open mystery packs to collect & battle with your own figures
👥 Hire staff & manage your shop
🏪 Expand your store to become the #1 destination for hobbyists!

Whether you're a miniature painter, strategy game fan, or just love a good sim game, this is your new happy place.

💬 Join our community & stay updated:
🔗 https://discord.gg/jpTj7CjzQ7

🧠 Developed with love by a passionate indie team.

🔔 Don’t forget to subscribe for updates and dev diaries!
#IndieGame #SimulatorGame #CozyGames #TabletopGameShopSimulator
